SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(lt.time) AS shortest_lap_time
FROM lapTimes AS lt

GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(MIN(lt.time), 1, INSTR(MIN(lt.time), ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000

)

  Q: What is the percentage of the most common conditions for patients age 60 and above?
